candidate: Coinbase Agentic Wallet MCP / Agentic Wallet CLI
purpose: Pre-funding evidence mapping against the isolated x402 signer boundary. This is documentation evidence only, not observed conformance.

first_party_observations.private_key_isolation: Coinbase documentation states private keys stay in Coinbase infrastructure and agents do not access them.
first_party_observations.x402_only_mcp_payment_surface: MCP payment tools support x402 requests; the MCP documentation states agents cannot transfer funds to arbitrary addresses.
first_party_observations.founder_only_funding: Funding/onramp is available only through the wallet UI and cannot be initiated by the agent.
first_party_observations.founder_only_limits: Max per-call and max per-session spending limits are configured in the wallet UI and cannot be changed by the agent.
first_party_observations.prepayment_quote_check: The MCP exposes a check-payment-requirements operation that checks endpoint cost without paying.
first_party_observations.network_scope: Documentation supports Base, Polygon and Solana; therefore Base-only enforcement is not established by the MCP documentation.
first_party_observations.daily_cap: Documentation describes per-call and per-session caps, not the required hard A$40 rolling/calendar daily cap.
first_party_observations.failed_payment_semantics: FAQ states failed payments deduct no funds.
first_party_observations.request_capability: CLI x402 pay supports a caller-provided --max-amount limit.

conformance_mapping.C01_transaction_cap_AUD25: PARTIAL_DOCUMENTED: per-call cap exists; AUD-denominated hard enforcement and FX treatment not observed.
conformance_mapping.C02_daily_cap_AUD40: NOT_DOCUMENTED: only per-session cap observed in first-party MCP docs.
conformance_mapping.C03_base_native_usdc_only: FAIL_AS_DOCUMENTED_DEFAULT: product supports Base, Polygon and Solana; no Base-only founder lock observed.
conformance_mapping.C04_recipient_allowlist: PARTIAL: MCP says no arbitrary transfers, but exact provider-recipient allowlist enforcement before signing is not evidenced.
conformance_mapping.C11_agent_cannot_mutate_policy: DOCUMENTED for wallet-UI spending limits; broader policy mutation surface still requires machine test.
conformance_mapping.C12_no_generic_signing_or_key_export: PARTIAL_DOCUMENTED: private keys are isolated and MCP restricts sensitive actions; generic signing absence must be machine-tested on the exact connected surface.

decision: Do not fund. Candidate is materially closer to the required no-secret boundary than an in-process signer, but it cannot pass Relay/QA until C01-C12 are machine-observed. The largest documented gaps are daily-cap semantics, Base-only pinning, exact recipient/resource binding, replay/expiry handling and revocation.
next_action: If this candidate is connected outside model-visible surfaces, configure the lowest possible per-call/session limits, leave balance at zero, then execute C01-C12 as zero-spend negative tests before any funding.
truthfulness: No wallet was connected, funded or exercised in this observation. Documentation claims are not treated as conformance evidence.
